verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਬਾਸ ਲੇਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਏਕ ਪਦਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise al kamal kamal baas let firai kaahoo(n) ek padham kai sa(n)paT samaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a bumble bee hops from one lotus flower to -another, but sucking nectar from anyone flower at the time of Sunset, it gets arrested in its box-like petals,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੰਛੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲ ਖਾਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਰਹਨੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਰਜਨੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise pa(n)chhee birakh birakh fal khaat firai barahane birakh baiThe rajanee bihaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a bird keeps hoping from one tree to the other eating all types of fruits but spends night on a branch of any tree,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਹਾਟਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਬਨਜ ਲੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau biaapaaree haaT haaT kai dhekhat firai birale kee haaT baiTh banaj lai jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a trader keeps seeing commodities in every shop but purchases goods from anyone of them,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਤਨ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੮੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee gur sabadh ratan khojat khojee koT madhe kaahoo sa(n)g ra(n)g lapaTaat hai ||589||

en.bdb: Similarly, the seeker of Guru's words searches the jewel mine: The True Guru. Amongst many fake Gurus, there is a rare saintly person in whose holy feet the seeker absorbs his mind, obtains Naam and dyes himself in the Lord's divine hue. (589)
